title: GCD ( 24.9, 36.9 ) is 12: arguments are truncated

source.quote: If a value is not an integer, it is truncated.
source.supports: the arguments are truncated before the divisor is computed

derivation: 24.9 truncates to 24 and 36.9 to 36 (rounding would give 25 and 37, whose divisor is 1). GCD ( 24, 36 ) is 12.
